findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_audit_exemption · Private data: get_deadlines, list_verifiers, check_audit_exemption, share_with_openaccountants · Public sink: share_with_openaccountants · Destructive: search_skills.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_audit_exemption · Private data: get_deadlines, list_verifiers, check_audit_exemption, share_with_openaccountants · Public sink: share_with_openaccountants · Destructive: search_skills

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
